'''Barry Mason Preedom''' (December 31, 1940 – May 4, 2025) was an American [[physicist]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/70112181/|title=USC researchers turn handicap into advantage|work=The Index-Journal|location=[[Greenwood, South Carolina]]|date=January 20, 1982|access-date=July 5, 2025|page=11|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{Closed access}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Preedom was born in [[Stamford, Connecticut]], the son of Louis Merle Preedom and Velma Kimball.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/thestate/name/barry-preedom-obituary?id=58596648|title=Barry Preedom Obituary (1940-2025)|work=[[The State (newspaper)|The State]]|date=June 9, 2025|access-date=July 5, 2025|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref> He attended St. John's High School, graduating in 1958.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/600928551/|title=Gets Science Award|work=[[Shreveport Journal|The Shreveport Journal]]|location=[[Shreveport, Louisiana]]|date=May 31, 1958|access-date=July 5, 2025|page=11|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{Closed access}}</ref> After graduating, he attended [[Spring Hill College]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BS degree]] in 1962. He also attended the [[University of Tennessee]], earning his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in 1964 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in [[nuclear physics]] in 1967.<ref name="b">{{Cite book|url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/American_men_and_women_of_science_A_Biog/hklHSQjJ28sC?hl=en|title=American Men & Women of Science:  A Biographical Directory of Today's Leaders in Physical, Biological, and Related Sciences|page=1353|publisher=Gale|date=1998|ISBN=9780835237482|first=R. R.|last=Bowker|via=[[Google Books]]}}</ref>

Preedom served as a professor in the department of [[physics]] and [[astronomy]] at the [[University of South Carolina]] from 1976 to  2006.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sc.edu/study/colleges_schools/artsandsciences/physics_and_astronomy/our_people/directory/preedom_barry.php|title=Barry Preedom|work=[[University of South Carolina]]|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sc.edu/about/offices_and_divisions/provost/forms/emeritifaculty_1997-2015.pdf|title=Emeriti Faculty 1997-2015|work=[[University of South Carolina]]|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1995, he was named a [[distinguished professor]].<ref name="b" />

== Death ==
Preedom died on May 4, 2025, in [[Pawleys Island, South Carolina]], at the age of 84.<ref name="a" />
